summaries.title: Beyond Simply Environment Scaling: Designing Effective Environment Distributions for Multimodal Agent Learning
summaries.organization: Chinese Academic of Science Institute of Automation
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**多模态与统一基座**（Multimodal）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Beyond Simply Environment Scaling** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖智能体运行脚手架（Agentic Harness），并引入 Ability-aware Environment Selection (AES), Hierarchical Difficulty Curriculum (HDC) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：For diversity, we propose **Ability-aware Environment Selection (AES)** to obtain diverse environment sets。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用感知-规划-工具执行闭环智能体架构。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We further analyze the limitations in current multimodal environment distributions through a series of experiments。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（However, we find that simply increasing the number of multimodal environments does not always benefit；Experiments show that AES and HDC effectively improve multimodal agent training）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 23 赞，出自 Chinese Academic of Science Institute of Automation），本工作为突破 **智能体脚手架、工具与技能 (Harness & Skills)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: SFT Conflicts, RL Coexists: A Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Multi-Task Learning for LLMs
summaries.organization: Chinese Academic of Science Institute of Automation
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **SFT Conflicts, RL Coexists** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、监督微调（Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)）。核心论点主张：Leveraging this insight, we propose Parallel-RL, a paradigm that decouples multi-task training, significantly improving efficiency and flexibility。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用分阶段渐进式训练/建模流水线、强化学习策略优化与奖励驱动对齐。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：Empirically, we trace this to the parameter level, observing that RL induces sparse and approximately orthogonal updates across tasks。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Leveraging this insight, we propose Parallel-RL, a paradigm that decouples multi-task training, significantly improving efficiency and flexibility）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 23 赞，出自 Chinese Academic of Science Institute of Automation），本工作为突破 **监督微调与参数高效适配 (SFT/LoRA)、可验证奖励与群组策略优化 (RLVR/GRPO)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: SimWAM: A Simple World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**具身智能与物理AI**（Embodied & VLA）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」痛点，作者围绕 **SimWAM** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖世界-动作模型（World-Action Model (WAM)）、流匹配（Flow Matching）、零样本泛化（Zero-Shot Generalization）。核心论点主张：We present SimWAM, a simple yet effective WAM that uses video generation purely as a training signal。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用免训练（Training-Free）/零样本适配机制、强化学习策略优化与奖励驱动对齐、迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：It co-trains a pretrained video expert and a lightweight action expert with joint flow matching。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Our SimWAM achieves 91.5 PDMS on NAVSIM, surpasses state-of-the-art WAM-based planners with substantially lower latency, and transfers zero-shot to nuScenes）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 20 赞，出自 H-EmbodVis），本工作为突破 **小语言模型与端侧推理 (SLM & Edge)、图像扩散与流匹配生成 (Diffusion & Flow)** 中的「推理延迟与高昂计算开销」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
